title: Fractions of Whole Numbers and Multiplying Fractions by Whole Numbers
seo_title: Grade 6 Fractions of Whole Numbers Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Find fractions of whole numbers; multiply common fractions and mixed numbers by whole numbers; recognise, describe and use the equivalence of division and fractions.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 6 worksheets: fractions of whole numbers and amounts, multiplying fractions by whole numbers and fraction problems. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: ÷ by the denominator, × by the numerator.
key_sub: Whole number × fraction: multiply the numerator.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • To find a fraction of a number, divide by the denominator and multiply by the numerator.
  • 38 of 240: 240 ÷ 8 = 30, 30 × 3 = 90.
  • Whole number × fraction: multiply the numerator. 5 × 23 = 103 = 3 13.
  • Division is a fraction: 3 ÷ 4 = 34.

Examples

Example

25 of R350

R350 ÷ 5 = R70

R70 × 2

Answer: R140

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Dividing by the numeratorDivide by the denominator first.
Multiplying the bottomOnly the numerator is multiplied.
The part leftRead what the question asks for.

The whole bar is 20. What is 35 × 20?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 20 ÷ 5 = 4 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 3 × 4 = 12. So 35 of 20 = 12. (Do not multiply the denominator by 20 as well: 60100 is just 35.)

items.q: The whole bar is 24. What is 34 × 24?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 24 ÷ 4 = 6 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 3 × 6 = 18. So 34 of 24 = 18.

items.q: The whole bar is 18. What is 23 × 18?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 18 ÷ 3 = 6 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 2 × 6 = 12. So 23 of 18 = 12.

items.q: The whole bar is 40. What is 58 × 40?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 40 ÷ 8 = 5 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 5 × 5 = 25. So 58 of 40 = 25.

items.q: The whole bar is 28. What is 47 × 28?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 28 ÷ 7 = 4 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 4 × 4 = 16. So 47 of 28 = 16.

items.q: 38 × 24 = ?
items.e: × means “of”. Divide by the denominator: 24 ÷ 8 = 3 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 3 × 3 = 9. So 38 of 24 = 9.

items.q: 36 × 34 = ?
items.e: × means “of”. Divide by the denominator: 36 ÷ 4 = 9 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 3 × 9 = 27. So 34 of 36 = 27.

items.q: Find 56 of 30.
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 30 ÷ 6 = 5 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 5 × 5 = 25. So 56 of 30 = 25.

items.q: 710 × 50 = ?
items.e: × means “of”. Divide by the denominator: 50 ÷ 10 = 5 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 7 × 5 = 35. So 710 of 50 = 35.

items.q: Find 29 of 45.
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 45 ÷ 9 = 5 in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 2 × 5 = 10. So 29 of 45 = 10.

items.q: What is 34 of 24 kg?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 24 ÷ 4 = 6 kg in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 3 × 6 = 18 kg. So 34 of 24 kg = 18 kg.

items.q: What is 25 of 35 m?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 35 ÷ 5 = 7 m in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 2 × 7 = 14 m. So 25 of 35 m = 14 m.

items.q: What is 23 of 60 min?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 60 ÷ 3 = 20 min in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 2 × 20 = 40 min. So 23 of 60 min = 40 min.

items.q: What is 58 of 64 cm?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 64 ÷ 8 = 8 cm in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 5 × 8 = 40 cm. So 58 of 64 cm = 40 cm.

items.q: What is 710 of 50 ℓ?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 50 ÷ 10 = 5 ℓ in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 7 × 5 = 35 ℓ. So 710 of 50 ℓ = 35 ℓ.

items.q: What is 35 of 2 500 m?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 2 500 ÷ 5 = 500 m in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 3 × 500 = 1 500 m. So 35 of 2 500 m = 1 500 m.

items.q: What is 56 of 42 km?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 42 ÷ 6 = 7 km in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 5 × 7 = 35 km. So 56 of 42 km = 35 km.

items.q: What is 49 of 54 mℓ?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 54 ÷ 9 = 6 mℓ in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 4 × 6 = 24 mℓ. So 49 of 54 mℓ = 24 mℓ.

items.q: What is 23 of 4 500 g?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 4 500 ÷ 3 = 1 500 g in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 2 × 1 500 = 3 000 g. So 23 of 4 500 g = 3 000 g.

items.q: What is 910 of 1 000 mℓ?
items.e: Divide by the denominator: 1 000 ÷ 10 = 100 mℓ in each part. Multiply by the numerator: 9 × 100 = 900 mℓ. So 910 of 1 000 mℓ = 900 mℓ.
